EC1: Pregnancy (a negative serum or urine pregnancy test should be available for women of child-bearing potential before study inclusion) or lactation
EC2: Women of childbearing potential who do not practice a medically accepted highly effective contraception during the trial and one month beyond
EC3: History of hypersensitivity to the investigational medicinal product or to any drug with similar chemical structure or to any excipient present in the pharmaceutical form of the investigational medicinal product
EC4: Participation in another clinical trial during the present clinical trial or within the last three months
EC5: Medical or psychological condition that would not permit completion of the trial or signing of informed consent
EC6: Use of a fibrinolytic agent [OR], surgical thrombectomy, [OR] interventional (catheter-directed) thrombus [OR] aspiration [OR] or lysis, or use of a cava filter [AND] to treat the index episode of PE
EC7: Treatment with any therapeutically dosed anticoagulant for more than 48 hours prior to enrolment
EC8: Need for long-term treatment with a low molecular weight heparin [OR], vitamin K antagonists [OR] or NOAC [OR], for an indication [NOT] other than the index PE episode, or for antiplatelet agents [NOT] except acetylsalicylic acid at a dosage =100 mg/day;
EC9: Active bleeding [OR] or known significant bleeding risk (e.g., gastrointestinal ulcer [OR], malignant neoplasms [OR], injuries [OR] or recent surgeries [OR] of the brain [OR], spinal cord [OR] or eyes, recent intracranial bleedings [OR], known or suspected esophagus varices [OR], aneurysms [OR] or intraspinal [OR] or intracranial vascular abnormalities)
EC10: Artificial heart valves [AND] requiring treatment with an anticoagulant
EC11: Renal insufficiency [AND] with estimated creatinine clearance <30 ml/min/1.73m2
EC12: Chronic liver disease [AND] with aminotransferase levels two times or more above the local upper limit of normal range
EC13: Concomitant administration of strong inhibitors of P-glycoprotein like ketoconazole [OR], cyclosporin [OR], itraconazole [OR] or dronedarone
EC14: Unwillingness or inability to adhere to treatment or to the follow-up visits
